reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI theme plugin providing presets, light and dark modes, per-area styling, backgrounds, typography, effects, custom CSS, and persisted configuration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供主题预设、明暗模式、分区样式、背景、字体、动效和自定义 CSS，并持久化保存配置。
summaries.en: Customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with theme presets, light and dark modes, per-area styles, backgrounds, fonts, effects, custom CSS, and persisted settings.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI appearance
persists theme settings in a local config.json file
uploads and serves local background images
loads background images from configured local paths or URLs
